title: Bravo,
text: Magnificent show, breathtaking artists who finish in a sweat. From the singer to the guitarist to the dancers, bravo. Thanks for the welcome and the very friendly service, very pleasant room and location. Only downside, we arrived at the scheduled time and we felt like we were eating in a rush for a 35 euro menu that does not deserve that price.
author: 681elro

title: Best show ever
text: Too good. Don’t miss this show. The performers are par excellence and very well managed performances
author: Amit_P

title: Excpetional
text: Intense show that appeals to all your senses. Artists are exceptional, from guitarists to singers and dancers. The welcome at the restaurant is also very pleasant. Experience that we warmly recommend.
author: emiliefF7131FK

title: Wonderful show
text: Really lovely. The performers were excellent and really seems to enjoy themselves and each other. Highly recommend!
author: AVRI_B

title: Soulful flamenco in intimate setting
text: The flaminco performance at Jardines de Zoraya was captivating.  The guitarist and male and female dancers were very passionate and talented and the 2 singers held their own.  Our tickets through Viator were less than if we had bought them directly from the venue.  I highly recommend this experience!
author: Karen_S

title: Top!
text:
Room on a human scale or even intimate. 1 guitarist on stage + 2 singers + 2 dancers.
They shared their energy and passion while conveying beautiful emotions.
A very nice discovery for us!!!!
author: pauline54300

title: Tolle Flamenco Show
text: We had booked the show in a package. The food was good. The staff friendly and funny. The flamenco show was great, as it was a testament to sporting excellence. Recommended.
author: 425Marc

title: Spectacle flaminco
text:
Passionate show, dancers, singers and guitarist filled with intensity and emotions.
We had an unforgettable time

title: Amazing!
text: Absolutely amazing and very authentic. Worth every penny! We were mesmerized and moved by the performance. Wonderful evening!

title: Very nice show
